I'm retiring from the IBL.

In case it wasn't obvious from me leaving IBL and all related servers, I have made the decision to fully withdraw from the IBL and its community. I never did this with expectation of external reward, as I simply got gratification from knowing the work I did was important. And yet, my contributions would barely be noticed or celebrated. In case it wasn't obvious from me leaving IBL and all related servers, I have made the decision to fully withdraw from the IBL and its community.
